description: Set Frame Fitting Options (Object > Fitting > Frame Fitting Options: fitting on empty frame, reference point, Auto-Fit and crop amounts), clear them (Clear Frame Fitting Options), and fit the content now, including Content-Aware Fit

autoFit.description: Auto-Fit: refit the content whenever the frame is resized

crop.description: Crop Amount (mm; negative adds space around the content)

fitNow.description: Fit the content now (Object > Fitting): content_aware is Content-Aware Fit

fitting.description: Fitting on Empty Frame: how content placed later is fitted

referencePoint.description: Align From: the reference point for fitting and cropping

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_frame_fitting
title: Set Frame Fitting
